pr.title: Unified Storage: support cross-namespace ListModifiedSince
pr.body:
## Summary

Allows `StorageBackend.ListModifiedSince` to be called with an empty namespace, returning rows across all namespaces for a given `(group, resource)`. Single-namespace callers are unchanged; the SQL template keeps namespace first when present so existing query plans are preserved.

- KV backend (`pkg/storage/unified/resource/storage_backend.go`): validation now requires only `group`/`resource`; data-store path detects boundaries on `(namespace, name)`; event-store path filters by `(group, resource)` always and applies the namespace filter only when set. Both paths dedup on `namespace + "/" + name` so same-named resources in different namespaces each yield once.
- SQL backend (`pkg/storage/unified/sql/backend.go` + `data/resource_history_list_since_modified.sql`): the `namespace = ?` predicate is conditional on a non-empty namespace argument; dedup mirrors the KV change. Removes the namespace-required check from `sqlResourceListModifiedSinceRequest.Validate()`.
- Tests: new cross-namespace subtest in `storage_backend_test.go` covering both event-store and data-store paths plus a missing-group/resource rejection case; new shared integration subtest in `testing/storage_backend.go`; new `cross-namespace` golden snapshot for mysql / postgres / sqlite dialects, single-namespace goldens updated for the reformatted `WHERE` clause.

## Test plan

- [x] `go test ./pkg/storage/unified/resource/ ./pkg/storage/unified/sql/`
- [x] Snapshot tests pass across mysql / postgres / sqlite dialects

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
